location.name: colorful flower garden
location.description: A cheerful preschool garden path surrounded by large red, yellow, and blue flowers.

characters.name: Lila
characters.description: A curious ladybug who helps preschool children notice colors.
characters.appearance: A small round red ladybug with black spots, large kind eyes, and a simple animated design.

character_actions.action: Lila walks beside one red flower, one yellow flower, and one blue flower, pausing at each color.

camera.description: A slow stable tracking view follows Lila along the flower path.

lighting.description: Soft sunny preschool animation lighting with clear friendly colors.

location.name: garden vegetable patch
location.description: The same cheerful garden continues beside red tomatoes, orange carrots, green leaves, and a blue watering can.

characters.name: Lila
characters.description: A curious ladybug who helps preschool children notice colors.
characters.appearance: A small round red ladybug with black spots, large kind eyes, and a simple animated design.

character_actions.action: Lila points to the vegetables and then waves beside the blue watering can.

camera.description: A gentle stable pan reveals the vegetables and finishes on Lila waving.

lighting.description: Soft sunny lighting matching the flower garden scene.
